plan.goal: Rasterize San Francisco census tracts to a binary mask using 100m resolution
plan.notes: Use the full extent of sanfrancisco_tracts_central for the raster extent. Burn value 1 for tract polygons. Output resolution: 100m. CRS: EPSG:26710 (matches source data).

plan.goal: Compute Euclidean distance raster from hospital point locations
plan.notes: Compute distance in meters from each 100m cell to the nearest hospital point. Use same 100m resolution and EPSG:26710 CRS as the census tract mask. Distance values represent distance to nearest hospital for every cell.

plan.goal: Mask the distance raster to census tract boundaries
plan.notes: Apply the census tract mask so output only contains distance values within census tract areas. Multiply or use conditional masking to keep only cells where tracts_mask = 1.

plan.goal: Finalize and verify the output distance raster
plan.notes: Rename and validate final output. Ensure output covers sanfrancisco_tracts_central bounds and maintains 100m cell size in EPSG:26710. Units are meters representing distance from census tract cells to nearest hospital.
